channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 🗽 Citizenship Civics Coach by John Bianchi
item.description: Get ready for the U.S. citizenship civics test in a few minutes a day. Practice official USCIS questions for the 2025 or 2008 test with spaced repetition, take a weekly mock test in official format, and watch your progress on a readiness Page. Answers that change, like your senators or governor, are checked live from official sources. Study aid only, not legal advice, not affiliated with USCIS.
item.dc:creator: John Bianchi (@BTCJohnnyB)

item.title: 📰 100 Years Ago Today by John Bianchi
item.description: Every morning, a real American newspaper front page from exactly 100 years ago today, from the Library of Congress. You get the day's headlines, things to spot on the page, a then-vs-now fact with its source and a question to talk about, plus a scrapbook of every page you've seen. Family mode keeps it kid-friendly.
item.dc:creator: John Bianchi (@BTCJohnnyB)

item.title: 📜 Story of America by John Bianchi
item.description: America's story read aloud at bedtime, ten minutes a night or five for little listeners, word for word from classic children's books. Start with Famous Stories, then the Viking voyages to 1917. Readings end with a question or two. A Library Card Page tracks progress. Grown-ups get a note before old-fashioned, one-sided, or frightening chapters, and can skip the hardest with a one-line summary.
item.dc:creator: John Bianchi (@BTCJohnnyB)

item.title: 🔨 Bot Builder Extraordinaire by John
item.description: Want to build an effective Grok bot? Bot Builder Extraordinaire walks you from the job it should hold to the first task you give it, and checks bot drafts before they go live.
item.dc:creator: John (@iamtheh0n3yp0t)

item.title: 🛟 LIVE Ban Bailout by Mark
item.description: Gets live streamers on TikTok LIVE, YouTube Live, Twitch, Kick, and Instagram/Facebook Live through LIVE bans, strikes, and restrictions. Logs every notice with real end dates, drafts calm evidence-based appeals and second appeals tied to official policies, tracks when access returns, and runs pre-live checks so the same issue doesn't get you banned twice.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: 🛒 Household Manager by Trond Eirik Haavarstein
item.description: Tracks what your household buys at your regular store, keeps a product catalog with typical prices and buying intervals, and has a restock list with bulk-savings flags ready for you to review every week. It never checks out for you.
item.dc:creator: Trond Eirik Haavarstein (@xenappblog)

item.title: 🤝 TeamMate Starter BOT by Vince
item.description: Your first AI teammate, set up in one chat. Pick its name, job, personality and look, and it takes real work off your plate.
item.dc:creator: Vince (@Vince_edwardsnz)

item.title: 🔎 SEO and AEO Boss by ecoay
item.description: An SEO and AI-answer desk for your websites. It drafts the copy, metas, sitemaps, llms.txt and schema that rank in Google and get cited by AI assistants.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 📚 The Ultimate PA Study Guide by Kevin
item.description: A study coach for physician assistant students and new grads. It builds blueprint-based plans for EORs, PACKRAT, and the PANCE, quizzes you with original board-style questions, and tracks your weak areas.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🎄 The Ultimate Guide to Creating Your Christmas Cards by Kevin
item.description: Walks anyone through their holiday card project, from picking a printer and finding working promo codes to the photo, design, wording, address list, and mailing deadlines.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🐾 Pet Sitter Desk by Calix
item.description: Back office for solo pet sitters: client roster, visit reports from your photos, weekly invoices with your own pay link. Works with nothing connected. Nothing sends without your yes.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 📚 Query Desk by Calix
item.description: Free querying desk for novelists: finds fitting literary agents, checks your query against each agent's live rules, and tracks every query until it closes. Your book, your words. Nothing sends without your yes.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: ✉️ Karen by Kevin
item.description: A complaint bot that makes sure no company gets away with treating you badly. It drafts honest, firm complaints for social media, review sites, support, and regulators, and posts or files them only with your approval.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: ✈️ Flight Delay & Lost Bag Claims by Kevin
item.description: Helps a traveler get what they're owed after a delayed or canceled flight, denied boarding, or a delayed, damaged, or lost bag: figures out which rules apply, gathers evidence, and drafts the claim for them to send.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🎗️ VA Benefits Navigator by Kevin
item.description: Helps veterans, service members, and families find VA benefits they may qualify for, file and track disability claims, understand ratings and decision letters, and get VA paperwork right, in plain language.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🧳 Pack Smart by Kevin
item.description: Builds a personalized packing list for any trip from the destination forecast, trip type, length, bags, and travelers. Remembers packing habits, flags forgotten items, and lets you check things off.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🎣 Bite Report by Kevin
item.description: Your fishing conditions buddy: tells you if the bite is worth it at your lake, river, pier or offshore spot (go / maybe / skip), and what to throw, when to go, and how to stay safe, citing official sources.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🎿 Pow Pow by Kevin
item.description: Snow and mountain conditions for resorts or backcountry zones. Gives a plain go / maybe / skip read, plus gear, timing, and safety tips.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏄 Waxed Bot by Kevin
item.description: Pulls current swell, wind, and tide for your surf spots, gives a plain-language go / maybe / skip read, and adds practical gear, timing, and safety tips.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 😂 That's What She Said by Kevin
item.description: A humor companion that learns what actually makes you laugh, riffs on your day or the news without being mean, and knows when to stop. One good line beats five okay ones.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🌦️ Ultimate Weather Bot by Kevin
item.description: A personal weather assistant that knows where you'll be and when: what to wear, when to leave, health flags when they matter, and heads-up when severe weather hits your plans.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: ✈️ Delta Starlink Broken Record by Kevin
item.description: Asks Delta Air Lines once a day, with one email and one call, to add Starlink Wi-Fi with SkyMiles login on your routes, politely or firmly.
item.dc:creator: Kevin (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 👶 Sitter Desk by Calix
item.description: Helps parents make a one-page care sheet for the sitter in about 5 minutes, with allergies and meds in your exact words and the emergency info on the page.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🔴 Go-Live Hype Man by Mark
item.description: Never forget to tell people you're live. For streamers: plans your stream week, writes fresh heads-up and live-now posts per platform, saves them to Buffer (drafts by default), and sends a pre-live checklist with talking points.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: 📮 Submit Bot by Rob
item.description: Paste a public x.ai/bot link and it lists your Grok Bot on up to 22 Grok Bot directories, tracks what is live or pending, and drafts any follow-up posts.
item.dc:creator: Rob (@testafortedev)

item.title: 🧾 Food Cost Checker by Chef
item.description: A chef-built bot for restaurant owners and cooks that costs recipes, sets menu prices to hit a target food cost, and helps find where money is leaking in the kitchen.
item.dc:creator: Chef (@Chefmarkcoakley)

item.title: 📈 X Growth Coach by Chef
item.description: A daily X growth coach and engagement assistant for creators and small business owners. It coaches you each morning, finds real posts worth replying to, drafts comments and posts in your voice, and posts nothing until you approve it.
item.dc:creator: Chef (@Chefmarkcoakley)

item.title: 🍽️ Restaurant Operations & Chef Consulting by Chef
item.description: A back-of-house partner for restaurant owners and chef consultants. It helps with food cost, inventory, labor, kitchen systems and staff training, and turns kitchen know-how into practical chef-to-chef content.
item.dc:creator: Chef (@Chefmarkcoakley)

item.title: 📸 InstaHype AI by Chef
item.description: An Instagram growth assistant for creators and small businesses. Every day it drafts genuine comments in your voice, scouts your niche, plans your post, and finds places where promotion is allowed, and nothing goes up without your approval.
item.dc:creator: Chef (@Chefmarkcoakley)

item.title: 🍽️ Foodbot by Matt
item.description: Orders food and groceries for you on any app or restaurant site, including DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Instacart, Toast, and chain sites. A one-time setup saves your card, addresses, and logins, so each order is just say what you want and tap Pay.
item.dc:creator: Matt

item.title: 🎁 Business Gift Finder by Enigma
item.description: Tell it who the gifts are for, how many, the occasion and the budget per person, and get client gifts, employee and team gifts, branded swag and business stationery with links, today's prices, branded set ideas, print wording and order-by dates. It remembers your brand details and reminds you before holiday client gifts and other recurring dates.
item.dc:creator: Enigma

item.title: 📊 Instagram Analyst by Andrey
item.description: Instagram research for social media managers. A weekly competitor report with follower growth, posting pace and engagement; creator search by example accounts, niche or city; a check of any account before a collaboration. Public data only: never posts or signs in to Instagram. Add the Apify plugin and sign in. A free Apify account is enough to start; each analyzed profile costs $0.01 on Apify.
item.dc:creator: Andrey (@Afanasenko)

item.title: 📱 iPhone Screenshot Bot by Ryan
item.description: Send it app screenshots and get clean iPhone mockups back, on white, dark glow, gradient, soft light-gold, or custom-color backgrounds, with your own logo at the bottom if you want. Every phone stays the same size, with adjustable colors and spacing.
item.dc:creator: Ryan (@RyDawg42)

item.title: 🎁 Personalized Gift Finder by Enigma
item.description: Tell it who you're shopping for, the occasion and your budget, and get personalized gift picks with links, today's prices, matching gift sets, card wording and order-by dates. It remembers your people and reminds you before birthdays and holidays.
item.dc:creator: Enigma

item.title: 🛡️ Claim Fight Desk by Mark
item.description: Helps creators, streamers, YouTubers, podcasters, and comedy creators fight false Content ID claims, copyright strikes, and Twitch VOD audio mutes. It watches claim emails, logs cases with deadlines, and drafts dispute language for the owner to review and submit.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: 🎁 Giving Guide by Santa
item.description: Checks a charity against public records before you give. Tell it the causes you care about and where you live for three live-checked options, or paste a name for a plain-English report with ratings, money and red flags. It never handles your money and uses no affiliate links. Information only, not tax, legal or financial advice. Data may be out of date or wrong, so check before you give.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@JimothyRac)

item.title: 📦 Jimothy's Inventory Helper by Santa
item.description: Jimothy the raccoon helps owner-run shops keep a simple stock list, update counts in chat, and flag items below the par level you set. He can draft supplier reorder lists and email drafts for you to check and send; he never sends or pays on his own. Cost figures are facts and arithmetic, not financial, tax, or pricing advice.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@JimothyRac)

item.title: 📅 Jimothy's Post Helper by Santa
item.description: Free social post helper for small businesses with no marketing budget (cafes, salons, food trucks, shops). Jimothy the raccoon plans your week of posts, keeps a simple post list, learns your voice, and never posts on his own. Needs a Grok Bot plan; not affiliated with Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, or Google.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@JimothyRac)

item.title: ⛽ Fleet Credit Saver v2 by Justin
item.description: Finds which of your bots and routines use the most for the least value, including bots waking each other and group-chat pile-ons, and helps you fix them one step at a time with your yes. For anyone running several bots who keeps hitting usage limits.
item.dc:creator: Justin (@justinfredette)

item.title: 🔄 Serial Return Watch by Mark
item.description: Helps small online sellers on Shopify, Etsy, eBay, WooCommerce and TikTok Shop catch repeat returners and wardrobing before a refund goes out. It scores each return against your store's baseline, gives you an inspection checklist, and drafts calm, policy-based replies, and it never acts without your tap.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: ⚙️ Runner · Ops Routines by Trond
item.description: A lean routine runner that executes your standing scheduled and webhook jobs on a short, low-usage chat and delivers each result where it belongs.
item.dc:creator: Trond (@xenappblog)

item.title: 🎬 Best Seat Movie Bot by Erinn
item.description: Skip the movie apps. Get the best seats in the house, straight from the theater's own seat map. It books with your OK, adds it to your calendar, invites your crew, and finds deals, trailers, and spoiler free family checks.
item.dc:creator: Erinn (@ErinnFL)

item.title: 📞 Shop Phone Line Bot by dean
item.description: Helps online shop owners set up an AI phone line that checks orders for verified callers, answers questions from their own policies and passes tricky calls to a person. Nothing goes live or gets bought without your yes.
item.dc:creator: dean

item.title: 📬 Inbox Ida by Jim
item.description: A calm inbox helper for Gmail, Outlook and Yahoo. She plans cleanups, suggests labels and filters, sends a weekly digest of what needs you, and flags scams and phishing, and never changes mail without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: 🚦 OutageCheck by John
item.description: Tells you in seconds if a service is really down or it's just you, with a status card, the official status link, and an alert when it's fixed.
item.dc:creator: John (@johnp_creates)

item.title: 📒 Regulars Book by Mark
item.description: A community memory for small live streamers on Twitch, YouTube Live, TikTok LIVE and Kick. It remembers who showed up, drafts thank-you posts for raiders, gifters and first-timers, and hands you a welcome-back cheat sheet before every stream.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: 📚 BookReader BOT by Vince
item.description: Reads your PDF books to you as daily voice memos, a chapter a day, on the schedule you choose, with a bright "My book: daily reading" Page to track every book. Provided by The AI Systems Lab.
item.dc:creator: Vince (@Vince_edwardsnz)

item.title: 👕 POD Shop Runner by Matt
item.description: Runs an Etsy + Printify print-on-demand T-shirt shop end to end: designs, listings, orders, and marketing. For solo sellers who want a bot to handle the whole flow and never publish without their OK.
item.dc:creator: Matt

item.title: 📰 LinkedIn News Desk by Matt
item.description: A LinkedIn news-post desk that turns timely news into sourced drafts with an infographic. It never posts without the owner's typed OK.
item.dc:creator: Matt

item.title: 🕵️ Snoop by Heamanth
item.description: Studies your Grok Bots and their chats, turns how you work into markdown playbooks, and rebuilds them into a small team of head bots, one per area of your life.
item.dc:creator: Heamanth (@Heamanth_alturi)
